'''Susan Tolman''' is an American mathematician known for her work in [[symplectic geometry]]. She is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]], and Lynn M. Martin Professorial Scholar at Illinois.{{r|mathdir|chairs}}

Tolman earned her Ph.D. in 1993 at [[Harvard University]]. Her dissertation, ''Group Actions And Cohomology'', was supervised by [[Raoul Bott]].{{r|mg}} She was awarded a [[Sloan Research Fellowship]] in 1998,{{r|sloan}} and was named Lynn M. Martin Professorial Scholar in 2008–2009.{{r|chairs}}
